description: Strict direct model with all 102 existing base features

exact_change: Replace the 87-column list with all 102 base features. Keep the strict temporal fitting protocol and all CatBoost settings fixed.

description: Expanded reliability and recent-career direct model
hypothesis: Rates other than success need explicit reliability, posterior shrinkage, and uncertainty; recent-career disagreements should be discounted for low-history pitchers.
exact_change: Start from all 102 base features. Add generic-prior posterior/deviation/uncertainty features for pitcher reverse, middle, ball, strike, batter middle/success, and pitch mix, plus reliability-weighted recent-career form and disagreement features.
